reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Unlawful operation or advertising without public warehouse license
headings.reviewNote: Reflecting prohibition on holding out as a public warehouseman or using storage in business name without compliance.

headings.title: Exemption for self-service storage facilities
headings.reviewNote: Noting non-applicability of sections 415.010 to 415.050 to self-service storage facilities under sections 415.400 to 415.430.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1939/1985 history note; confirmed public warehouseman compliance/advertising bar (including use of word 'storage') and exemption for self-service storage facilities.

headings.title: Prohibition on residential use of leased space
headings.reviewNote: Reflecting restrictions against operator permitting and occupant using leased space for residential purposes.

headings.title: Operator entry for protection and preservation of facility or property
headings.reviewNote: Regarding operator authority to enter leased space for reasonably necessary protection and preservation.

headings.title: Occupant disclosure of valid liens and third-party property owners
headings.reviewNote: Requiring occupant written statement or rental agreement disclosure of existing lienholders and third-party owners.

headings.title: Written disclosure of lessor casualty insurance status
headings.reviewNote: Requiring written disclosure to lessee regarding presence or absence of lessor casualty insurance.

headings.title: Contractual limit on stored property value and owner liability
headings.reviewNote: Establishing rental agreement value limit as maximum stored property value and maximum owner damage liability.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all five subsections and 1985–2014 history note; confirmed residential-use ban, operator preservation entry, occupant lien/third-party disclosures, written casualty-insurance notice, and contractual value/liability cap.

headings.title: Operator lien on stored property and priority over unperfected liens
headings.reviewNote: Regarding operator lien for rent and charges, priority over unperfected liens, and required bold rental agreement notice.

headings.title: Enforcement of lien and sale of property after default
headings.reviewNote: Authorizing cash sale or disposal of worthless property when occupant default exceeds 45 days.

headings.title: Application of sale proceeds and disposition of surplus
headings.reviewNote: Governs sale proceeds application, one-year surplus holding (with sworn indemnity affidavit), and unclaimed property escheat; archived text cites 'this subsection' rather than subsection 2.

headings.title: Prerequisites and notices required prior to sale
headings.reviewNote: Requires 45-day default notice (first-class or electronic mail), second default notice after 10 days (verified or electronic mail), and 7-day classified newspaper ad.

headings.title: Treatment and towing of unpaid vehicles, watercraft, or trailers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizing owner to treat unpaid vehicles, watercraft, or trailers as abandoned and tow after 60 days with immunity.

headings.title: Occupant redemption of personal property prior to sale
headings.reviewNote: Permitting occupant to pay amount necessary to satisfy lien and redeem personal property at any time before sale.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all six subsections and 1985–2014 history note; confirmed operator lien priority, 45-day default sale, surplus escheat (noting archived text cites 'this subsection' in sub 3), pre-sale notices, 60-day vehicle/watercraft/trailer towing, and redemption.

headings.title: Definition of late fee and exclusion from interest or collection expenses
headings.reviewNote: Defining late fee and distinguishing it from debt interest or reasonable collection and lien enforcement expenses.

headings.title: Requirement of written late fee provision in rental agreement
headings.reviewNote: Conditioning collection of late fees on express statement in rental agreement or addendum.

headings.title: Permissible imposition of reasonable monthly late fee
headings.reviewNote: Authorizing operator to impose reasonable late fee for each month rent is unpaid when due.

headings.title: Statutory safe harbor for twenty-dollar or twenty-percent late fee
headings.reviewNote: Establishing statutory presumption that late fee of greater of $20 or 20% of monthly rent is reasonable and non-penal.

headings.title: Operator burden of proof for higher late fees
headings.reviewNote: Placing burden of proof on operator to establish reasonableness of late fees exceeding statutory safe harbor.

headings.title: Recovery of reasonable collection and lien enforcement expenses
headings.reviewNote: Permitting operator to recover reasonable collection and lien enforcement expenses in addition to late fees.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all six subsections and 2001/2014 history note; confirmed late fee definition, written rental-agreement mandate, monthly assessment, $20/20% safe harbor, higher-fee burden of proof, and collection/lien expense recovery.

headings.title: Rights of good faith purchaser at lien sale
headings.reviewNote: Establishing good faith purchaser acquires property free and clear of all rights and lienholder claims.

headings.title: Limitation of operator liability upon statutory compliance
headings.reviewNote: Limiting operator liability to net sale proceeds when operator complies with statutory sale procedures.

headings.title: Denial of occupant access to leased space upon default
headings.reviewNote: Authorizing operator to deny occupant access to leased space upon default.

headings.title: Notice delivery methods and effective delivery
headings.reviewNote: Specifying delivery of notices by verified mail or email and defining when delivery is deemed complete.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 1985–2014 history note; confirmed good-faith purchaser protection, net-proceeds liability cap, default access denial, and verified-mail/email notice delivery rules.
